title: Ganga swarg se zameen par kaise aayin?
hooks: Socho agar swarg se paani ka ek vishal sailab seedhe zameen par girta, toh kya hota?
Kya aapko pata hai Ganga ji ko zameen par lane ke liye kya karna pada tha?
Bhagirath ki tapasya aisi thi ki bade-bade devta bhi hairan reh gaye the!
hook_why: Starts with a relatable high-stakes visual question that instantly hooks viewers.
metaphor: A celestial river descending from the cosmic realms down to earth, guided by devotion.
